interfaces.clock_note: engineering choice: HSI16 as SYSCLK, 0 flash wait states; board clock is an explicit engineering responsibility and is NOT printed by the paper

formulas.S: distance between the two harvesters; NOT printed by the paper -> explicit assumption TC_SENSOR_SPACING_MM

frame.transport: UART2 9600 8N1 explicit rebuild; the paper does not publish a wireless protocol

interfaces.load_source: TENG + front-end stored energy (behavioural single-unit anchors only: 2.2 mW average, 49.722 uJ/cycle); transmit admission is a computed budget, never a measurement

polarity.exti_trigger: rising edge only; debounce/noise rejection is done in traffic_core.c
polarity.wheel_onset: rising edge = wheel first contact; inputs active-high with internal pull-down

interfaces.runtime: freestanding: no C library is linked; memset/memcpy/memmove are provided by mini_libc.c; arithmetic is 32-bit integer only (no 64-bit divide helpers)

native_readback.scope: Solver output integrity only; no circuit acceptance or calibration.

assumptions_explicit: 5 Hz excitation, two 25 ms rectified bursts per 200 ms cycle, 120 uA peak, 1 ms edges
rectifier modelled as idealised diode IS=1e-12 N=1.0 RS=10 ohm
release latch modelled as comparator with RC positive feedback (5.0 V / 3.0 V, 40 mV softness, 10 ms feedback); real device not modelled
load modelled as 2.2 kohm equivalent stand-in for the reporting event
interfaces.load_source: 2.2 kohm equivalent load, switched by the 5 V/3 V release latch
interfaces.polarity: bursts are the already-rectified charge delivery; bridge output positive at node nca
interfaces.scope: bounded sub-circuit downstream of the triboelectric transducer; generation mechanism, real diode/threshold-switch parts and array-scale claims are NOT modelled
interfaces.subsystem: RTE harvester power stage: rectifier + 1000 uF storage + 5 V/3 V release latch + load (P05)

evaluation.scope: Exact native file/build readback only; source semantics, functional checks and complete product acceptance remain separate.

delivery_integrity.scope: Actual listed file hashes and native input/assembly version; functional and product acceptance remain separate.
